explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the source of comfort, strength, and love for believers.
To give hope and relief to those who suffer or are in grief through God's presence.
To strengthen the Christian community morally and spiritually so that it can stand firm against difficulties.
The trust in a future reunion with Christ, even when facing persecution or distress.
The ability to endure suffering without losing faith in God's plan and justice.
The firm trust in God that holds Christians together in community even when they are separated from one another.
A deep bond of care among children of God, driven by living according to God's will.
